lifecycle.reason: The declared causal ReLU attention core is not semantically equivalent to softmax SDPA or another allowed single-call library path.

publication.note: Static migration is complete; refreshed MUSA correctness and timing evidence is still required before release.

target_environment.note: The task names the environment it was measured in and leaves the device model, architecture and component versions in that record. Latencies are comparable only within one snapshot_id.

golden_oracle.note: Independent CPU oracle: the framework exports the deterministically initialized public constructor state, then the oracle evaluates the projection and causal ReLU attention definition with NumPy float64 arithmetic.

tensor_contract.note: float32 only, which is what every A-tier measurement in sets/attention was taken at and what the hand-written kernels in this repository were tuned for.

submission.note: A Python module defining ModelNew, with no library compute in the declared attention core.

kernel_scope.enforced_note: The audit rejects a call to a fused attention entry point. It does not reject every torch op, because an nn.Linear holding weights and an nn.Linear computing a projection are the same source and only the author knows which is which; the two lists below are what a reader audits against.
kernel_scope.note: The reference never applies its output projection, so there is none to leave in or take out of the library.

scoring.ranking: A-kernel track only; never merged or averaged with the B-library track

denominator_policy.fallback_condition: only when exact semantic equivalence is established and upstream_musa is unavailable or degenerate

build.note: §5 step 8's order: the static audit runs before this build, so a rejected submission never spends a compile.

self_test.note: Runs without a device: case overrides, golden cross-check and the source audit.

abi.inputs: in-process torch tensors generated from the declared Case contract
abi.transport: Python ModelNew invocation in the evaluator process
abi.runner: musa_operator_eval/evaluator/run_task.py, which imports torch through the framework's evaluator

hyperparameters.activation: relu on the causally masked attention scores; no softmax
